title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
why_read: A copycat of the HackerTube idea applied to books, same shallow technical substance.
analysis: This project mirrors the HackerTube concept but surfaces books mentioned on Hacker News instead of videos. It's likely a similarly simple scrape-and-list app with no significant engineering novelty. Worth a skim for book recommendations but not for technical learning.
